svg.text: From user input to an explainable crop-allocation recommendation on official Tamil Nadu data
for the chosen district and season
TNAU dose, MSP and CACP cost;
Datasets are validated, cleaned and imported once (scripts/preprocess_all.py, also at Docker build); each request reads them through app/data/loader.py (cached per process).
The fuzzy stage runs only where an official reservoir reading exists for the district and season; otherwise it is skipped and flagged (yield left unadjusted).
Features without an official dataset (e.g. live weather) return HTTP 501 instead of estimated values.
Source: AgroOptimize backend (app/), frontend (frontend/src) and docs/data_architecture, branch feature/official-data-migration
